log_character_single_frame: log a single character frame with skeleton, mesh, and locators to the Rerun viewer
log_animation_multi_frame: log a multi-frame character animation using batched columnar sends for high-throughput visualization
log_mesh_3d: log a posed 3D mesh with optional vertex colors or albedo factor to Rerun
log_joints_skeleton: log skeleton bones as line strips and per-joint transforms to the Rerun viewer
log_locators_positions: log character locator world-space positions as colored 3D points to Rerun
